versions.subject: Merge PR #4521 from @netgrain - Add New Rules Related To Pikabot
versions.detection:
selection_grandparent:
    GrandParentImage|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
selection_cmdline:
    CommandLine:
        # Note: Only add strings as seen used by Pikabot to avoid collision with other strains of malware
        - 'ipconfig.exe /all'
        - 'netstat.exe -aon'
        - 'whoami.exe /all'
condition: all of selection_*

selection:

versions.subject: Merge PR #4678 from @swachchhanda000 - Adds and updates Pikabot and rundll32 related rules
versions.detection:
selection_parent:
    - GrandParentImage|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
    - ParentImage|endswith:
          - '\SearchFilterHost.exe'
          - '\SearchProtocolHost.exe'
selection_child:
    CommandLine:
        # Note: Only add strings as seen used by Pikabot to avoid collision with other strains of malware
        - 'ipconfig.exe /all'
        - 'netstat.exe -aon'
        - 'whoami.exe /all'
condition: all of selection_*
versions.spl: GrandParentImage="*\\rundll32.exe" OR ParentImage IN ("*\\SearchFilterHost.exe", "*\\SearchProtocolHost.exe") CommandLine IN ("ipconfig.exe /all", "netstat.exe -aon", "whoami.exe /all")
